data.key: Hunter Animal Companion Trick ~ Vengeance Strike
data.name: Vengeance Strike
data.description: The ranger can use this trick as an immediate action when an enemy adjacent to him hits an ally with a melee or ranged attack. The ranger can make a single melee attack at his highest base attack bonus against the creature who attacked his ally.
